description: This Java class 'SystemPatchApplier' runs at application startup to apply no-downtime data updates when the package PATCH version increases. It updates database views, widget types, and system schema versions, using advisory locks to prevent concurrent execution.

classes.name: SystemPatchApplier
classes.description: A service class that applies system data patches at startup, including updating database views and widget types based on version changes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the patch application process in a separate thread after bean construction.

methods.name: applyPatchIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks version changes and applies database updates and widget type updates if needed, using advisory locks.

methods.name: isVersionChanged
methods.description: Determines if the package version has increased compared to the database version.

methods.name: isPatchVersionChanged
methods.description: Checks if the patch version component has increased.

methods.name: updateSqlViews
methods.description: Executes SQL script to update database views.

methods.name: updateWidgetTypes
methods.description: Updates widget types from JSON files in the designated directory.

methods.name: updateWidgetTypeFromFile
methods.description: Updates a widget type based on JSON file content if it has changed.

methods.name: isWidgetTypeChanged
methods.description: Checks if the widget type has changed based on descriptor, name, or description.

methods.name: isDescriptorEqual
methods.description: Compares two descriptor JSON nodes for equality using checksum.

methods.name: computeChecksum
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 checksum of a JSON node's canonical string.

methods.name: acquireAdvisoryLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a PostgreSQL advisory lock to prevent concurrent patch updates.

methods.name: parseVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into major, minor, maintenance, and patch components.

methods.name: listDir
methods.description: Lists directory contents, returning an empty stream if directory does not exist.
